newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans, meal up sharply on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans, meal up sharply on fund buying.

text.p: CBOT July soybeans and soymeal shot higher in fast, late-session trading as commodity funds bought and local traders covered short positions, traders said.
"Some funds came in and bought the market and that sparked short covering," said a floor trader.
Floor sources estimated that locals covered about two million bushels of July soybeans.
Buy-stop orders were also tripped in July soybeans and soymeal after the market made new highs for the day, traders said.
At 1300 CDT, July soybeans were six cents per bushel higher at $8.32, and July soymeal was up $3.10 at $274.00.
